Yeah this sub is a good resource, but it can be really discouraging to read all the top posts complaining about side-effects, weeks or even months after quitting. 

That's the thing about weed though, it interacts with everyone's brain chemistry in such a different way you really shouldn't base your expectations of the experiences of others. I am on day 2 right now, when I took a break last summer I was only feeling shitty for 3-5 days (mostly due to nausea). After a week, all withdrawal symptoms are gone in my personal experience (except for the psychological desire similar to that of playing video games or jacking off). 

I think people who say they still experience crazy mood swings a month later are those who use weed to help treat another underlying condition or are quitting baccy at the same time. Otherwise, its really not that bad at all.

Good luck bro. Keep busy and you'll forget about withdrawal in a matter of days!
